Expedited Passport 2026: Every Legitimate Way to Get It Fast

Updated July 17, 2026Sources: travel.state.gov · USPS
The short answer: There are three legitimate speeds: (1) Expedited service — add $60 to any application or renewal, processing drops to about 2-3 weeks plus mailing; (2) Regional passport agency — free appointment via 1-877-487-2778 if you travel within 14 days, often same-day issuance; (3) Life-or-death emergency service — travel within 72 hours due to an immediate family emergency abroad, with documentation. No private "expediter" can move faster than route 2.

Passport panic has a market: private expediters charge hundreds of dollars for routes you can access yourself, often at exactly the same speed. Here is the complete, official menu — fastest last.

Route 1: Expedited processing (+$60) — about 2-3 weeks

  • Available for any application: first-time (at an acceptance facility), mail renewal, or online renewal.
  • Cost: your normal fee + $60. For a first adult book: $165 + $60 = $225.
  • Mark "EXPEDITE" on the envelope for mail renewals; select expedited for online.
  • Add 1-2 day return delivery (~$23) if the calendar is tight — mailing time is NOT included in processing time.

Route 2: Regional passport agency — travel within 14 days

  • 27 agencies nationwide handle urgent travel by appointment only: call 1-877-487-2778. The appointment itself is free (you pay normal fees + $60 expedite).
  • You must show proof of international travel within 14 days (or a foreign visa need within 28 days).
  • Straightforward cases often leave with a passport the same day.
  • Find your closest one in our agency directory.

Route 3: Life-or-death emergency — travel within 72 hours

If an immediate family member abroad is seriously ill, injured or has died and you must travel within 72 hours, the same phone line has emergency prompts. Bring documentation (hospital statement or death certificate, translated if needed) plus proof of travel.

What about private expediting companies?

Registered couriers can hand-carry applications to agencies, which helps mainly when you cannot appear in person. They cannot jump the queue beyond what routes 1-2 offer, and their service fees ($100-500+) come on top of all government fees. Exhaust the official routes first.

Reality check on timelines

  • Routine processing: typically 4-8 weeks depending on season — check current times on travel.state.gov before planning.
  • Expedited: about 2-3 weeks processing, plus up to 2 weeks total mailing.
  • Agency appointment: same day to a few days, for qualified urgent travel only.

Frequently asked questions

Is the $60 expedite fee refundable if it still arrives late?

No. The fee buys priority processing, not a guaranteed delivery date. If your deadline is under three weeks, aim for an agency appointment instead.

Can I expedite a child's passport?

Yes — same +$60 on top of the $135 child total, applied in person at an acceptance facility since minors always apply in person.

Do I need to buy a plane ticket before an agency appointment?

You need proof of imminent travel — an itinerary or reservation is generally acceptable. Many travelers book refundable options for the appointment.
